brief:
美国中期选举后的“AI 交易退潮”成为今日市场主线：随着 AI 概念股回落，投资者开始重新审视亚洲配置，长期被冷落的中国与印度股票、以及受益于通胀放缓与贸易摩擦缓和的公司重新获得关注。科技债务格局同步生变，Meta 在选举日当天完成250亿美元公司债发行，被解读为超大规模科技企业融资环境正在被重新定价。伯克希尔·哈撒韦三季度斥资约96亿美元回购自家股票，但保险承保业务走弱拖累经营利润，呈现“回购加码、盈利承压”的混合季度。中国方面，据央视援引《2026全球能源转型报告》，中国2026年能源投资预计达9400亿美元，居全球首位。公司层面，币安首席财务官 Kaiser Ng 卸任、Justin Yek 接任；软银与 ABB 正探讨中国业务剥离方案以挽救机器人交易；特斯拉将在明年拆解 Cybertruck 产线前增加班次清理订单。

**Top5**

1. **AI 交易退潮，亚洲“被遗忘的交易”回归**：AI 概念回调迫使投资者重写亚洲投资剧本，中国与印度部分冷门板块重获需求。 [阅读原文](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-11-08/ai-slump-revives-asia-s-forgotten-trades-from-china-to-india)
2. **Meta 250亿美元债券发行折射科技债新格局**：在选举日大额发债原本被视为冒险，最终结果显示市场对超大规模科技企业债务的胃口仍强。 [阅读原文](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-11-07/meta-s-bond-sale-shows-new-reality-for-tech-debt-credit-weekly)
3. **伯克希尔加速回购，经营利润下滑**：三季度回购约96亿美元，管理层显然认为股价被低估，但保险承保疲弱拖累整体盈利。 [阅读原文](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-11-07/berkshire-hathaway-s-operating-earnings-fall-buybacks-rise)
4. **中国2026年能源投资预计9400亿美元，全球第一**：报告称中国将连续领跑全球能源投资，规模超过任何其他国家。 [阅读原文](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-11-08/china-set-to-lead-world-in-energy-investment-in-2026-cctv-says)
5. **软银与 ABB 探讨中国业务剥离以挽救机器人交易**：双方正评估 carve-out 方案，以应对监管障碍、保住这笔机器人业务交易。 [阅读原文](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMizAFBVV95cUxPMV9yYXBHcG8tbzdLTG85N2NjSlNJTmgwUlVFSmU5eEM2WVdpQUtfY2U1SXJ0VkxJSWV6RXpDVnEtR0dHdzZQWnlmd2ZnRjZjdnZndzlOMzJqUjNwNmN1Y2tGQVBSUkdualpEdnNaRWRVbzV2cnR2YnJYaVR2amdURkZ4WHdGbENYN2QyYUd6UjlDTGZVUTVFQ0lKdExaZkNrM2NJYlhSZXRjY0N1aFNjcGJqVjM5ZlpfaHg2OXdCWmF0OHYwd0FndXo1dXI?oc=5)

补充：中国将2027年二十大代表名额设为2360名，比上届增加60名；澳大利亚房屋销售与拍卖清盘率回升，楼市出现复苏早期迹象；特斯拉计划在明年拆解 Cybertruck 产线前增加一个班次以清理订单；加沙强降雨淹没流离失所者帐篷，援助短缺拖累响应。

items.title: China Set to Lead World in Energy Investment in 2026, CCTV Says
items.summary: China is expected to invest $940 billion in energy in 2026, the most by any country, according to the Global Energy Transition Report 2026 released by the China Enterprise Reform and Development Society, China Central Television reported Sunday.

items.title: China Raises Delegate Count to 2,360 for 2027 Party Congress
items.summary: China set a quota of 2,360 delegates for the Communist Party’s 21st national congress in 2027, 60 more than for the previous gathering, Xinhua News Agency reported Sunday, citing the party’s Organization Department.

items.title: AI Slump Revives Asia’s Forgotten Trades From China to India
items.summary: The unraveling of the AI trade after the US midterm elections is forcing investors to rethink their Asia playbook, reviving demand for out-of-favor Chinese and Indian stocks as well as companies poised to benefit from easing inflation and trade tensions.

items.title: Australia Home Sales Rise in Fledgling Sign of Property Recovery
items.summary: Australian home sales and auction clearance rates climbed, offering hopes of a recovery for a property market that has slumped as interest rates rose this year.

items.summary: Selling billions of dollars of corporate bonds on Election Day seemed like a real gamble.

items.title: Top Turkish Regulators Taken Into Custody in Fund Probe
items.summary: Turkish authorities detained top officials from the country’s regulators on Saturday, local media reported, the latest executives to be caught up in a widening fund scandal.
